title: Window
description: The window module displays the title and app ID of the currently focused window in the Mango compositor.

placeholders.description: The app ID of the focused window.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format string. See FORMAT REPLACEMENTS.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

rewrite.label: Rewrite
rewrite.doc: Rules to rewrite the window title. Each key is a regular expression and its value is the replacement string. Captures can be used with $1, $2, etc.
rewrite.description: Rules to rewrite the window title. Each key is a regular expression and its value is the replacement string. Captures can be used with $1, $2, etc.

icon.label: Icon
icon.doc: Whether to show the application icon.
icon.description: Whether to show the application icon.

icon-size.label: Icon size
icon-size.doc: Size of the application icon in pixels.
icon-size.description: Size of the application icon in pixels.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables the module to consume all leftover space.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in character the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.
